source:
A massive storm has destroyed most of the city. Players choose how they want to live in the aftermath.

Roles
👮 Police
🚑 Paramedic
🔥 Firefighter
🛠️ Mechanic
🧑‍🌾 Farmer
🛒 Shop Owner
🏠 Builder
🦹 Criminal
👨‍👩‍👧 Civilian
Features
Build and decorate your own home.
Buy and customize vehicles.
Start businesses like cafés, gas stations, or clothing stores.
Dynamic weather (storms, floods, heatwaves).
Jobs with progression and pay.
Optional PvP zones, with safe RP areas for players who don't want combat.
Seasonal events and community missions.
What makes it different

Instead of just living a normal city life, everyone works together to rebuild the town after disasters. New events keep changing the world, giving players fresh roleplay opportunities.

It mixes the everyday roleplay of games like Brookhaven with survival and rebuilding mechanics to make the world feel more dynamic

answers.ask: Should the city read as mostly wrecked and being clawed back, or mostly rebuilt with damage as flavour?
answers.answer: The city should read as mostly wrecked and actively being clawed back after the storm, with clear damage, debris, and incomplete rebuilding throughout.

answers.ask: How much city - a few neighbourhoods, or a sprawl with farms and outskirts? This may need the larger region frame.
answers.answer: Use a few compact neighbourhoods with a small farm/outskirts area, keeping the first map focused on a playable rebuilding community rather than a large sprawl.

config.genre_evidence: Players "choose how they want to live in the aftermath" through civilian and service roles, can "build and decorate your own home," customize vehicles, start businesses, and use "safe RP areas." The compact neighbourhoods are built as a shared rebuilding community for everyday roleplay. Jobs with progression/pay add Simulation, disaster conditions add Survival elements, and optional PvP zones add Action, but none defines the primary layout.
config.evidence: "Build and decorate your own home," plus "Buy and customize vehicles" and a focused rebuilding town with player-run businesses support personal buildable plots, vehicle roads, enterable venues, and a community hub.
config.addendum:
LAYOUT FEATURES for this Roleplay & Avatar Sim map. Build these as the actual structure of the space rather than as set dressing, keep them visually distinct from one another, and keep the whole layout legible in one view.

SHAPE OF THE SPACE - Personalized Plots: Uniform, flat, square lot footprints on a strict grid where players cleanly spawn and build their own houses.

INCLUDE:
- Vehicle Road Network: Wide, flat, grid-aligned streets — 15 studs minimum one-way, 30 studs two-way — snaking between residential and commercial zones so vehicle meshes turn without clipping walls.
- Enterable Interior: Shops, homes, and venues players go inside.
- Town Square Core: A central, deliberately oversized gathering hub built to handle maximum avatar density without traffic jams.
